<!--
SHARED CHUNK: everyone (logistic regression, tree, PCA) should use this
exact cleaning + split so the model comparison is fair.
-->

### Data Preparation

```{r load-clean}
data_url <- paste0("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ShawnAgaon/",
                   "Stat-380---Heart-Failure-/main/heart.csv")
heart <- read.csv(data_url)

# Convert categorical predictors to factors
heart$Sex            <- as.factor(heart$Sex)
heart$ChestPainType  <- as.factor(heart$ChestPainType)
heart$FastingBS      <- as.factor(heart$FastingBS)
heart$RestingECG     <- as.factor(heart$RestingECG)
heart$ExerciseAngina <- as.factor(heart$ExerciseAngina)
heart$ST_Slope       <- as.factor(heart$ST_Slope)

# Cholesterol = 0 and RestingBP = 0 are physically impossible -> treat as missing
sum(heart$Cholesterol == 0)
sum(heart$RestingBP == 0)
heart$chol_missing <- as.integer(heart$Cholesterol == 0)
heart$Cholesterol[heart$Cholesterol == 0] <- NA
heart$RestingBP[heart$RestingBP == 0]     <- NA
```

```{r split}
# Stratified 80/20 split (seed 380, as used in class)
set.seed(380)
no_disease <- which(heart$HeartDisease == 0)
disease    <- which(heart$HeartDisease == 1)
train_idx  <- c(sample(no_disease, round(0.8 * length(no_disease))),
                sample(disease,    round(0.8 * length(disease))))
train <- heart[train_idx, ]
test  <- heart[-train_idx, ]

# Impute with TRAINING medians only (avoids leaking test information)
chol_med <- median(train$Cholesterol, na.rm = TRUE)
bp_med   <- median(train$RestingBP,   na.rm = TRUE)
train$Cholesterol[is.na(train$Cholesterol)] <- chol_med
test$Cholesterol[is.na(test$Cholesterol)]   <- chol_med
train$RestingBP[is.na(train$RestingBP)]     <- bp_med
test$RestingBP[is.na(test$RestingBP)]       <- bp_med

# Classification models need a factor response; "1" = heart disease
train$HeartDisease <- factor(train$HeartDisease, levels = c(0, 1))
test$HeartDisease  <- factor(test$HeartDisease,  levels = c(0, 1))

c(train = nrow(train), test = nrow(test))
```
